baseline_models.focus_anchor: yuridu kullu imri'in minhum an yu'ta suhufan munashsharatan: willing, every person, passive receipt, written sheets, and their opened state all occur in the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah distributes one desire across every individual, places the desired act in passive receipt, and specifies plural written sheets already opened. The result is not merely a wish for information but a wish for an individually issued, immediately inspectable documentary grant.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention make yuridu an inwardly owned demand that drives the entire construction.
Totality and completeness make the demand distributive across the whole set, one person at a time.
The person image supplies the individual human claimant rather than an undifferentiated crowd.
Granting and bringing locate agency in an unnamed giver and cast the individual as recipient.
The written-sheet image makes the desired grant documentary rather than merely verbal.
The open-document image makes each written object exposed and available for direct inspection.

changed_reading.before: Every person wants to be given some papers.
changed_reading.after: Every individual claims an individually issued, already open documentary communication that can be inspected without mediation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: suhufan munashsharatan combines plural sheets with an adjective of opening and spreading.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sheet inventory holds both flat breadth and collection into a codex, while munashsharah holds opening, spreading, branching, and an open written document. Their combination foregrounds document architecture: separate leaves laid out or circulated, in contrast to a closed or collected corpus.

activation_trace.role: Flat spread and breadth give the sheets a material surface capable of being laid out.
Collecting sheets into a codex supplies the live opposite of the requested unbound, opened plurality.
Opening, spreading, and branching turn the adjective into a spatial and distributive operation.
An open written document joins the material spreading directly to documentary publication.

changed_reading.before: The requested objects are generic written messages.
changed_reading.after: The demand concerns publication form as well as content: separate writings must arrive unbound, unfolded, and fully exposed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The desired suhuf are explicitly written sheets, and the same focus inventory includes misreading from sheets.
baseline_models.mechanism: The documentary medium offers visible text but also creates the possibility of textual misreading. Munashsharah removes physical closure, not interpretive failure, so the focus can already distinguish access to writing from secure understanding.

activation_trace.role: Misreading from written sheets supplies the medium's internal failure mode.
The open-document image maximizes physical access while leaving the misreading risk intact.

changed_reading.before: A demand for written proof is a demand for certainty.
changed_reading.after: The demand privileges a visibly open written medium, even though that same medium does not guarantee a sound reading.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus uses passive yu'ta and asks for sheets already munashsharah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of coming from elsewhere and outsider arrival amplify the passive form: each claimant imagines evidence crossing toward him from an external source, already opened and arranged, rather than requiring him to approach or work through it.

activation_trace.role: A torrent arriving from elsewhere supplies forceful external arrival as the delivery image.
The outsider entering another people sharpens the sense of evidence imported from beyond the claimant's sphere.
Written sheets specify what the external arrival is expected to deliver.
Opening and spreading make the incoming evidence preprocessed for immediate access.

changed_reading.after: Each person expects proof to travel in from outside and arrive already opened, shifting all epistemic labor toward the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's first direct singular address produces rising and warning, whereas 74:52 imagines direct personal communication as something each individual passively receives. Personalized address is thus recast from a commission carrying work into a private documentary entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Granting and bringing make the focus individual's role passive receipt.
The written sheet is the personalized object expected in place of an imperative commission.
Resolve and rising into a task make the opening personal address immediately action-producing.
Warning that awakens caution identifies the outward duty generated by that address.

structural_cues: 74:1-7 turns one direct address into a chain of imperatives; 74:52 turns desired directness into passive receipt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening commission and the later passive request; I infer that the latter seeks personal address without its burden. A live alternative is that the sheets are sought precisely to enable comparable action.

changed_reading.before: Each person wants a message addressed directly to him.
changed_reading.after: Each person wants the privilege of direct address while reversing its surah-level grammar from commanded service to private receipt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier recipient is furnished, then hopes for increase, then resists visible signs. The focus generalizes that appetite from one figure to every person: personalized sheets become the next requested increment after prior provision failed to produce responsiveness.

activation_trace.role: Will and inward inclination make the focus demand the continuation of an appetite.
The granting image frames the sheets as another benefit expected from a giver.
The heart's coveting and hope supply the appetite that persists after abundance.
Seeking an increase turns prior gifts into a platform for the next demand.
The visible-sign image shows that more provision follows resistance to signs already manifest.

structural_cues: 74:11-16 sequences creation and provision, hope for more, and stubbornness toward signs before 74:52 distributes wanting across every person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, appetite for increase, and resistance to signs; I infer that the later document request continues the same escalation logic. Alternatively, 74:52 may describe a distinct and sincere evidentiary request.

changed_reading.before: The sheets are requested as missing evidence.
changed_reading.after: The sheets function as the next personalized grant demanded by an appetite that converted earlier gifts and signs into grounds for asking for more.

context_deltas.mechanism: A small counted disclosure in 74:31 is explicitly an assay producing certainty, growth, doubt, or protest. Those already given the Book encounter that test through a joined written corpus; the focus demand for separate open sheets seeks an individualized disclosure format that would remove compression, ambiguity, and shared mediation.

activation_trace.role: Collecting sheets into a codex supplies the organized-corpus pole from which separate sheets can diverge.
Opening, spreading, and branching make the requested alternative maximally unfolded and distributed.
Assaying metal or a person makes limited disclosure an instrument that reveals the respondent.
Stable knowledge and removal of doubt name one possible result of undergoing rather than abolishing the test.
Granting identifies recipients already given scripture, providing a direct control case for focus yu'ta.
Joining one thing to another gives the Book a collected structure opposed to individually scattered leaves.

structural_cues: 74:30-31 moves from a finite count to its test function and divergent reader effects; 74:52 asks for plural open documents per individual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the counted test, its divergent effects, given Book recipients, and the focus's open sheets; I infer that exhaustive personal disclosure is meant to bypass the assay. It could instead be an honest request for the same certainty reached by Book recipients.

changed_reading.before: They want clearer evidence in writing.
changed_reading.after: They demand a personalized and exhaustively unfolded disclosure regime in place of a compact sign whose very function is to test the reader.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is for whoever wills to advance or remain behind; later, every person wills to be given sheets. The repeated volitional frame changes its complement from self-movement to passive receipt, making the document demand a substitute for the response already left to each person.

activation_trace.role: Will and intention supply the focus's volitional frame.
Granting makes the desired complement passive acquisition rather than movement.
Will attached to a thing supplies the earlier parallel choice construction.
Advancing forward makes one complement of willing an enacted change of position.
Deferral to a later position supplies the alternative to advancing and preserves personal agency either way.

structural_cues: 74:36-38 places warning, voluntary advance or delay, and liability in sequence; 74:52 redirects willing toward receipt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two volitional constructions with active movement in one and passive granting in the other; I infer a displacement of response by receipt. A live alternative is that receiving sheets is imagined as the prerequisite for moving forward.

changed_reading.before: They exercise choice by asking for documents.
changed_reading.after: They redirect choice away from advancing or holding back and toward making an external giver perform the decisive action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact distributive kull pairs every focus claimant with every liable self. Against passive receipt of written sheets, 74:38 places each self under what it acquired and images it as a document or object held against a right. The wanted sheet can therefore function as an imagined externally issued counter-document to one's earned liability.

activation_trace.role: Totality distributes the document demand to every individual without exception.
Granting makes the desired record externally supplied rather than personally produced.
The written-sheet image gives the wished-for counterweight a documentary form.
The repeated totality image creates an exact every-person to every-self alignment.
The very self or identity fixes liability on the same individual who later asks for a sheet.
Seeking and acquiring makes the binding record arise from the person's own gain or action.
A document or object held against a right supplies the legal-material image of personal liability.

structural_cues: 74:38 and 74:52 repeat kull while reversing the individual's relation to an object: held by what one acquired versus wishing to be given writings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact distributive repetition, own acquisition, collateral, passive grant, and written sheets; I infer that the desired writ is imagined as offsetting the earned record. Alternatively, the two individualized statements may contrast responsibility and evidence without implying substitution.

changed_reading.before: Each person wants an individually addressed revelation.
changed_reading.after: Each liable self wants an externally issued writ that could outrank, release, or overwrite the account generated by its own acquisition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers identify failures of feeding, disciplined participation, and truthfulness toward reckoning; then certainty comes to them. The same arrival root sought in the focus has already been narrated, but at the endpoint and too late. More delivered pages therefore cannot be isolated as the missing cure for a practical and social refusal.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival make focus yu'ta resonate with the later arrival of certainty.
Written sheets specify the informational remedy the claimants imagine.
Feeding another identifies an omitted outward practice rather than missing information.
Entering discourse or an affair identifies participatory drift as part of the failure.
Contradiction of truth makes denial, not documentary absence, an explicit mechanism.
Accounting and recompense identify the denied horizon that gives the omissions consequence.
Arrival supplies the exact event structure the focus requests, now attached to certainty.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed shows that conclusive evidence eventually arrives without repairing prior conduct.

structural_cues: 74:43-47 is a first-person causal inventory ending with certainty's arrival; 74:52 later requests another arrival in documentary form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies omitted acts, discursive participation, denial, and eventual certainty; I infer that the focus demand misdiagnoses a practical refusal as an information deficit. A live alternative is that earlier personal sheets could have changed those acts before certainty arrived.

changed_reading.before: Personal written certainty would solve the problem.
changed_reading.after: The requested arrival repeats an arrival already guaranteed at the endpoint, while the narrated failures concern conduct and denial that open sheets alone do not repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, turning away becomes recoil and flight under pursuit; bal then replaces the animal image with the wish for personal sheets. The request is activated as a countercondition for engagement: the shared reminder is rejected unless revelation changes medium, ownership, and addressee for every claimant.

activation_trace.role: Soliciting another toward an act and contending with another will make the request an attempt to set terms for the giver.
Written sheets name the replacement medium demanded as a condition of engagement.
The open-document image makes full personal exposure the requested condition.
That which reminds identifies the already available communicative object from which they turn.
Turning one's side away supplies deliberate bodily and attentional disengagement.
Recoil and distancing intensify disengagement into active aversion.
Flight makes avoidance the immediate motion that bal in the focus redescribes.
Pursuit supplies the pressure against which the preceding flight is staged.

structural_cues: 74:49-52 forms an uninterrupted question, simile of recoil and flight, then bal plus the personalized document demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct adjacency, bal, reminder-aversion, flight, and the requested replacement medium; I infer that the request rationalizes the flight by setting an impossible engagement condition. Alternatively, it may be a genuine request arising after fear-driven recoil.

changed_reading.before: After fleeing, they ask for stronger proof.
changed_reading.after: Their demand for one open dossier per person is the human-language form of the flight itself: engagement is deferred until the reminder is privately reissued on their terms.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate correction after the document demand denies fear of the later life. This relocates the problem from the amount or format of evidence to anticipated harm: personalized open sheets mask refusal to let the future horizon govern present response.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets embody the ostensibly missing evidence whose absence the request foregrounds.
The open-document image makes lack of access especially difficult to sustain as the ultimate issue.
Dread that anticipates the disliked supplies the affective relation explicitly denied.
Laterness after what is first gives the feared or unfelt object its temporal horizon.

structural_cues: 74:52 is followed immediately by kalla, bal, and the denial of fear in 74:53.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate corrective diagnosis after the request; I infer that evidence-format language masks a temporal-affective refusal. Alternatively, lack of fear and desire for personalized status could be parallel motives rather than cause and cover.

changed_reading.before: The objection is epistemic: the available message is insufficiently explicit.
changed_reading.after: The epistemic demand is a surface form for refusing an unwelcome future, so multiplying open pages would leave the governing disposition intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close of the surah answers individually owned sheets with a reminder that must be remembered, a human willing nested under divine willing, and relations of protection and forgiveness. The desired artifact is thus displaced by enacted recollection and dependence: possession of a private document is not the endpoint named by the surah.

activation_trace.role: Contending with another will makes the focus request an attempted negotiation over revelatory terms.
The written sheet gives the desired relation a possessable material object.
That which reminds names the available function of the revelation without multiplying private artifacts.
Will attached to its object restores human volition as willingness to remember rather than to receive.
Placing the self in protection supplies an enacted orientation rather than documentary ownership.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer names release as a relation, not a credential the claimant controls.

structural_cues: 74:54-56 answers 74:52-53 with reminder, willing remembrance, divine willing, protection, and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a possessable focus object and a closing chain of reminder, will, protection, and forgiveness; I infer a contrast between ownership and enacted relation. A live alternative is that private sheets could themselves serve as instruments of remembrance.

changed_reading.before: Each person seeks a private revelation-object that can secure response and standing.
changed_reading.after: The private artifact demand tries to turn remembrance and dependence into controllable property, while the close relocates efficacy in remembering, willing, protection, and forgiveness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because imri' and suhuf ordinarily give person and sheets, not diner and dishes. It remains anchored in the focus inventories' palatable-food, eating, and broad-dish images and is activated by the explicit failure to feed another at 74:44. Downstream prose should present it only as an appetite-and-distribution echo, never as a lexical translation of 74:52.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: imri'in and suhufan carry packet branches for palatable food or eating and for a broad shallow dish, while munashsharatan supplies spreading.

activation_trace.role: Palatable food lets the individual-person slot acquire an appetite echo without replacing its syntax.
Eating and feeding extend that echo into a distributive relation between taking and giving food.
A broad shallow dish gives the requested sheet an anomalous serving-vessel silhouette.
Opening and spreading convert the vessel silhouette into an individually laid-out spread.
Feeding another activates the social contrast between wanting one's own spread and withholding food from another.

changed_reading.before: Every person wants his own open sheets.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, every person wants an individually delivered spread or dish while the surah records failure to feed someone without means.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because munashsharah most directly describes opened or spread sheets, not resurrected records. It remains lexically anchored in the focus root's explicit revival branch and gains same-surah pressure from rising and the immediately named later life. Render it as a secondary resurrection resonance in the requested pages, not as the adjective's primary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: munashsharatan is anchored to ن ش ر, whose focus inventory includes reviving the dead after death.

activation_trace.role: Written sheets provide the records capable of bearing the revival resonance.
Reviving the dead after death lets opening a document flicker as bringing a record back into active exposure.
Resurrection and rising of the Hour activate the revival branch from the surah's opening command.
Laterness supplies the afterlife horizon immediately following the focus.
Anticipatory dread, explicitly denied, makes revived records threatening rather than merely informative.

changed_reading.before: They want documents opened for them now.
changed_reading.after: The opened sheets faintly resemble records revived into exposure, an ironic request from people said not to fear the later life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because passive yu'ta normally foregrounds being given something beneficial, whereas the cited focus branch is an imposed levy. It remains anchored in the packet's ء ت ي inventory and coheres with collateral and debt images elsewhere in the packet. Downstream prose should qualify it as a legal-economic inversion of the requested grant, not as a replacement gloss for yu'ta.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: yu'ta is the passive delivery verb, and its focus inventory includes the imposed payment or levy branch; suhuf supplies the written instrument.

activation_trace.role: An imposed payment or levy reverses the expected grant into an assessment delivered to the claimant.
Written sheets let the reversed grant take the form of a bill, assessment, or record.
A document or object held for a right supplies collateral backing for the assessment image.
Financial debt makes the desired incoming paper capable of recording an obligation rather than a privilege.

changed_reading.before: Each claimant expects a personal documentary gift.
changed_reading.after: The wished-for delivery may invert into a personal assessment: the open sheet arrives as the instrument of what is owed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface yuridu is ordinarily resolved through ر و د, while the packet preserves a non-dominant split mapping to ر د د. The rejection branch remains formally authorized by that packet mapping and is contextually activated by turning away from the reminder. Render it only as a shadow mechanism inside the wanting, never as the direct lexical translation of yuridu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: yuridu is the focus verb, and its split focus inventory preserves the non-dominant ر د د rejection branch alongside dominant willing.

activation_trace.role: Refusing acceptance or returning something as invalid lets the desire operate as a rejection condition.
Written sheets specify the alternative whose absence is used to return the existing communication.
The reminder is the already available item against which the rejection condition operates.
Turning one's side away gives the split rejection branch a visible contextual action.

changed_reading.after: Their positive-sounding desire carries a contained rejection shadow: without customized pages, each person returns the shared reminder as unacceptable.

strongest_changes: The exact kull repetition links every claimant in 74:52 to every liable self in 74:38, turning a wished-for received writ into a possible counter-document against one's acquired collateral.
The test and Book sequence in 74:31 recasts open personal sheets as an attempt to replace assaying, compressed disclosure with exhaustive individualized disclosure.
The immediate 74:49-53 sequence recasts the request as both a condition of flight from the reminder and a cover for not fearing the later life.
The contrast between willing to advance or delay and willing to be passively given shifts agency from response to receipt.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation made the focus's ordinary grammar unusually relational: exact repetitions of giving, willing, and totality tied personalized open documents to already-given scripture, enacted choice, earned liability, eventual certainty, flight, and final remembrance. The branch inventories also exposed material legal and alimentary echoes that a topic summary would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The giver of the requested sheets is grammatically unstated, so the degree of claimed divine authorization remains inferred.
Munashsharah can emphasize physical unfolding, public circulation, separate personal dispatches, or several of these at once.
The counter-document and test-cancellation readings depend on sequence and material analogy rather than an explicit causal statement.
The dish, revival, levy, and non-dominant rejection activations are deliberately contained branch echoes, not primary lexical renderings.
